'''2011 US Nationals Kevin Shannon DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2011 US Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Shannon
* '''Deck name:''' Imperial Palace
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
